title: Hatsune Miku — By The Lakeside〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI
Lake

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: There really is a lake...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you find this place, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yes...
Mafuyu, Len and I came to see what it was...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really...?
Still, what made this lake appear?
Don't you already know?
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO... MEIKO, Luka, you too?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, we're all here now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, how can we not visit a new place after hearing about it?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm just here to see what's in this SEKAI now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Same here. We're not here out of just mere curiosity like the rest of you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Curiosity can serve as the beginning of many new things. There's nothing wrong with doing a little exploring.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, aside from the lake, this place is terribly dull.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, it does feel kinda lonely.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If only it had a little more scenery to offer. It's unfortunate that it didn't turn out like one of those summer retreats.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I don't think this SEKAI experiences summers...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Depending on how Mafuyu's feelings change, we may get an opportunity to go on a fun vacation...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: There's no way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: B-But... If that did happen, then that means Mafuyu would also be having fun, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu having fun...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: At the very least, that's not happening any time soon...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But there probably is some meaning behind us discovering this place...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I agree with her. But...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Um, KAITO?
You implied just now that there's only one reason this lake formed. Can you explain what you meant?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This SEKAI was born out of Mafuyu's feelings. Therefore, this lake is no different.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Which means something changed inside of her.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Precisely.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Something's changed with Mafuyu's feelings...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we can hear Kanade's song coming from it. Also, we found this study guide in the water...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Those may also be because of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: A study guide...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: For what exactly?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I believe it was for getting into medical school...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: All this pain seemed to wash over Mafuyu when she realized what it was...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: That means other painful memories may also be hiding within this lake.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In other words, this place wasn't entirely formed for refuge.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Mafuyu doesn't seem to enjoy being here either.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: I've heard enough. I'll be going now...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Same. I'll be leaving as well...
se_walk_women_001_1
se_walk_men_001_1

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh... There they go...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, Miku, have you noticed anything?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Have I...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You've known Mafuyu the longest out of all of us. That puts you in a unique position, which means you must've noticed something.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: This may not always be the case, but the water didn't feel all that cold when I touched it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah, I thought the same thing...!
It wasn't warm, but it wasn't cold either.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: The things closest to Mafuyu's heart lay hidden within these waters. Which thankfully aren't cold.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
The temperature...
That's very interesting.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, we'll likely want to keep an eye on this place moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*
